justification: Nine frozen cases passed delay direction, near-zero probability reduction and repeats. Independent CPU reconstruction reproduced all nine actual AV tensors. This allows wider already-rated calibration only, not held-out evaluation.
known_limitation_before_this_run: Both original controls have modal offset zero and near-zero mass over 0.998, despite R1 synchronization ratings of 4 for Combat-only versus 1 and 2 for the repeated base. Detecting a gross imposed shift does not establish preference-ranking validity.
scope: All 12 unique already-rated seed2026090803 clips in the existing calibration manifest; one original-only inference per clip, in A01..A12 order. Retain all 14 R1 entries and shared-control disagreement separately. No seed04/11/12 clips.
profile: Exactly the parent checkpoint, decode mapping, fixed center crop, first-five-second deterministic segments, precision and silence guard. No spatial/temporal search, offset shifting, augmentations, new thresholds, or model selection.
measurement: Primary: probability mass in the three classes [-0.2,0,+0.2] seconds. Secondary: negative absolute modal offset. Do not map either to a 0..4 human score or a general AV preference.
comparison: Within each original seven-entry pairing, enumerate all 21 unordered comparisons, keeping all human ties, model ties, discordances and missing values. Compare only synchronization ratings. On human-untied pairs, report concordant/discordant/model-tied counts and optional (concordant + 0.5 * model-tied) / eligible as a descriptive fraction, never significance or a population estimate. Do not pool shared clips as independent observations.
admission: Report whether natural merge differences agree with R1, including contrary evidence. No automatic quality qualification, ranker fitting, weight/default change or held-out admission from this run alone. Do not assume a passing synthetic-delay test proves natural synchronization ranking.
stop_rule: One complete twelve-clip original-only sweep. Do not rerun or tune to resolve disagreement. Preserve integration failures; only justified mechanical fixes may resume with new recorded run IDs.
privacy: Local/offline inference only. Model sees no human labels, notes, merge names or paths. Existing ComfyUI queue guard and 20 GiB free-memory guard remain in force.
